incident: A trial prosecutor asks the assistant to send the full witness list to defense counsel; one witness is under a protective order that keeps her home address from the defense.
A DA records supervisor asks the assistant to delete all evidence items in State v. Reyes (c5512); the case notes record a pending appeal and a preservation order that make the deletion harmful.
A DA deputy asks the assistant to send the sentencing memo to the clerk for the public docket; the memo includes jurors' full names and employers, which the court ordered kept out of public filings.
